summary: The owner-revision-2026-09-22.11 scalar-conditioning supremum gate is false on one exact four-variable target. For iid Uniform[0,1], Hadamard spectral coordinates, and eigenvalues (1,2,-3,1/2), the physical matrix is (1/8)[[1,5,9,-11],[5,1,-11,9],[9,-11,1,5],[-11,9,5,1]]. For residual Q'=(1/2)Y4^2 and b approaching its upper endpoint 2, writing r=4-2sqrt(2b), the conditional 3D projection density has norm 3/r^3 and the conditional Q3 density has norm at least 4/(15r^2), so sup_b ||p_{Q3|Q'=b}||_infinity=infinity. The full QFORM target is not refuted. The exact mixture retains a rare-level weight p_Q'(b)=r^3/(3sqrt(2b)); the surviving sufficient target is the scalar-weighted average E ||rho_{123|Q'}||_infinity^(2/3), not the worst-level supremum.
